look.why: A soft misty rainforest seafoam teal that frames the bold black-and-white saddle pattern cleanly.

size.measure: snout tip to tail tip, about 2.3 m (body 1.8–2.5 m plus 5–10 cm stubby tail per ADW)

habitat.text: Tropical lowland and hill rainforests across Sumatra, Peninsular Malaysia, southern Thailand and southern Myanmar.

diet.text: Tender shoots, leaves, twigs, aquatic plants and fallen forest fruits gathered with its flexible trunk-like snout.

facts.text: Its bold black-and-white saddle looks striking in daylight, yet breaks up its outline like boulders in moonlit jungle shadows.
The largest of the four tapir species and the only one native to Asia, closely related to horses and rhinoceroses.

id.habitat: Hutan hujan tropis dataran rendah dan perbukitan di Sumatra, Semenanjung Malaya, Thailand selatan, dan Myanmar selatan.
id.diet: Pucuk daun lembut, ranting, tumbuhan air, dan buah hutan yang dipetik dengan belalai pendeknya yang lentur.
facts: Pola pelana hitam-putihnya menyamarkan siluet tubuhnya seperti batu besar di bawah cahaya bulan hutan hujan.
Spesies tapir terbesar dari empat jenis yang ada dan satu-satunya yang berasal dari Asia; berkerabat dekat dengan kuda dan badak.
